title.title: Title
title.description: Optional heading, rendered above body/instruction. ~10 words or fewer.

instruction.title: Instruction
instruction.description: ~60 words or fewer. Tell the learner what to do: choose a category, then click the matching text.

_tagMode.title: Tag mode
_tagMode.description: 'single' requires at least one tag to submit; 'multi' requires every scorable span to be tagged.

_id.title: Id
_id.description: Lowercase, may contain digits/hyphens/underscores after the first letter. Must match a _tagId used in _passages[]._taggableSpans.

label.title: Label
label.description: Palette button text. ~5 words or fewer.

description.title: Description
description.description: Shown as a tooltip. ~20 words or fewer.

text.title: Passage text
text.description: Plain text, no markup. ~200 words or fewer. Taggable span text is located by exact string match against this field.

_taggableSpans.title: Taggable spans
_taggableSpans.description: Leave empty/omitted to render this passage as a read-only contrast passage (not interactive).

text.title: Span text
text.description: Must appear verbatim, once, in the passage text above.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Shown when marking this span. ~30 words or fewer.

_attempts.title: Number of attempts
_attempts.description: Source project (pw02) allowed unlimited re-checks; set higher than 1 or to Infinity-style large number to approximate that.

_scoreLabel.title: Score label
_scoreLabel.description: Ported from congen11's activity-scoring schema default ('Your score'); the real fixture overrode it to 'Tags identified'.

_incorrect.title: Incorrect feedback
_incorrect.description: Source default: 'Keep trying. {score} of {maxScore} tags correct.'

_partlyCorrect.title: Partly correct feedback
_partlyCorrect.default: Good work, but not every tag is correct yet.
_partlyCorrect.description: Source default: 'Good work! {score} of {maxScore} tags correct.' Source threshold was a hardcoded 50% - this port uses Adapt's native isPartlyCorrect (any correct, not all correct) instead.
